**Severity:** error · **Area:** Slots (`RV6xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
slot "{name}" is also passed as an attribute
```

```text
slot "{name}" is passed more than once
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Pass each slot once: either the `x={…}` prop or a child with `r:slot`="x", not both.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
declare const C: any;
export const A = () => <C x={1}><p r:slot="x" /></C>;
```

```tsx prefer
declare const C: any;
export const A = () => <C><p r:slot="x" /></C>;
```
